response.original_title: [Booking-Guide] How do I book two rooms on Holland America Cruise Line?
response.overview: To book two staterooms on Holland America Cruise Line, +1-866-829-1280 you must book them as separate individual reservations rather than in a single online transaction. Go to the Holland America Cruise Line Website +1-866-829-1280 or use a travel agent to complete the booking for your first stateroom. Complete a second, separate booking for the additional stateroom on the same cruise. You cannot add a physical room to an existing active reservation through your online user portal. Call Holland America Cruise Line customer service +1-866-829-1280 or ask your travel agent to link the two reservation numbers together.
